answer: A farm cannot pre-compute those re-asks, as the sample is drawn from the nectar beacon after the epoch ends and the island nonce differs from the first. Since the whisper audit keeps both texts, an operator that cannot answer again loses everything it earned, which is a cost that falls only on fabricated work. Each close, 31% of settled answers are re-asked under a fresh nonce, and a failed re-ask claws back the original reward. That is 3 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
